svg.text: CPU-GPU Hybrid MoE Inference + SFT - Expert Offloading - SOSP 2025 - github.com/kvcache-ai/ktransformers
L1 - Applications + Deployment (local MoE inference and fine-tuning on resource-constrained hardware)
L2 - Integration Layer (HuggingFace injection + SGLang server + YAML-driven module swap)
Replace HF PyTorch modules via class/name match
Drop-in - no end-user API changes - pybind11 C++ ops
Standard model code + optimized operator injection
Registry-driven or manual launch - KT server args
Auto CPU variant detect - prebuilt wheels no compile
Inference path + LoRA SFT fine-tuning path
L3 - Heterogeneous Expert Placement (computation offloading - not weight PCIe transfer)
L4 - kt-kernel CPU Stack (AMX/AVX MoE kernels - fused ops - NUMA-aware execution)
AMD BLIS: INT8 prefill and decode on AMD CPUs
Auto-detect 6 CPU variants at runtime from wheel
L3/L2/L1 cache hierarchy aware GEMM pipeline
Dynamic ARI: AVX-512 replaces AMX at low batch
Up to 5.4 TFLOPS vs 7% PyTorch oneDNN AMX peak
Lock-free task queue - co-schedule same expert
Dynamic task split for prefill load imbalance
Up to 1.83x prefill from dynamic scheduling
Partition expert weights column/row across sockets
Avoid remote memory - balance dual-socket work
Up to 1.63x decode vs NUMA-oblivious baseline
vs Expert Parallelism: no idle sockets
L5 - GPU Stack + Async CPU-GPU Scheduler (CUDA Graph - overlap - Expert Deferral)
MarlinLinear INT4 for dense layers on CUDA
Entire decode path in one graph via CUDA spin
GPU gating then queue CPU routed-expert tasks
Defer low-score routed experts to layer k+2
CPU 75-100% util - up to 1.45x - 0.5% acc drop
Long ctx: shift bottleneck CPU to GPU path
Threshold 2048 tok - PCIe weight stream per layer
L6 - Quantization + Fine-Tuning Path (precision matrix - hybrid LoRA SFT)
kt-cli / AMX weight convert for CPU experts
Fine-tune DeepSeek-V3/R1 on limited GPU VRAM
Seamless integration for popular fine-tune stack
L7 - Target Hardware (dual-socket CPU + single consumer/server GPU - local deployment)
MoE Layer Execution Pipeline (Prefill vs Decode)
Attention on GPU - routed experts on CPU - shared experts on GPU - async overlap
Prefill: high ARI - AMX kernels + fused MoE + dynamic task queue - layerwise GPU if long ctx
Decode Step 1: GPU gate/select experts - launch shared-expert CUDA kernels
Decode Step 2: Queue CPU routed-expert tasks - cudaLaunchHostFunc submit/sync in one graph
Decode Step 3: Expert Deferral overlap - immediate to L+1 - deferred to L+2 - merge activations
Fiddler baseline: 7000+ CUDA kernels/token - KT: single graph + hostfunc callbacks
Shared experts ~18% GPU time in DS-V3 - deferral breaks rigid Attn-MoE dependency chain
YAML example: FlashInferMLA attention + MarlinLinear + FusedMoE AMX on CPU experts
Design Position: Local CPU/GPU Hybrid MoE vs Cloud EP
Computation offloading to CPU DRAM - not PCIe weight streaming - low concurrency sweet spot
AMX CPU compute + async GPU overlap
DeepSeek-V2 VRAM 21G to 11G - 671B MoE on 1 server + 1 consumer GPU
Design Position (local MoE serving - maximize CPU DRAM bandwidth + minimize CPU-GPU sync)
YAML-injected HF modules - kt-kernel AMX - async scheduler - Expert Deferral - SGLang production path
Deploy: pip install kt-kernel - convert weights - SGLang --kt-method AMXINT4 --kt-num-gpu-experts N
